injection_details.method: Reflective DLL injection (manual in-memory PE mapping): VirtualAlloc(RWX, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE) at preferred ImageBase with fallback to arbitrary address, memcpy of PE headers and each section, process DIR64 (type 10) base relocations, resolve imports via LoadLibraryA/GetProcAddress (name and ordinal), then locate exported 'DllMain' by walking the export name table (strcmp) and call DllMain(base, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, NULL)
injection_details.target_process: self (current process) — no remote process injection
injection_details.target_discovery: No process discovery; the payload is an embedded 32-byte blob (g_encrypted_dll in .data @ 0x140004000) decrypted in place and mapped into the same process
injection_details.payload_write: memcpy of headers (SizeOfHeaders) and sections into VirtualAlloc'ed PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE memory
injection_details.entry_invocation: Calls the loaded image's exported 'DllMain' with (hinstDLL=mapped base, fdwReason=1 DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, lpvReserved=NULL)
injection_details.note: The decrypted 32-byte payload does not begin with 'MZ', so get_nt_headers fails and reflective_load returns -1 gracefully; the process then sleeps 2000 ms and exits 0

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom AES-128-like block cipher (NOT standard AES): 16-byte blocks (ECB-style), 10 rounds of per-byte operation state[i] = AES_forward_S-box[state[i]] XOR key[i] XOR (27*round mod 256). Uses the standard AES forward S-box table (g_aes_sbox @ .rdata 0x140005000). Function names from symbols: aes128_decrypt_block, aes128_decrypt
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in plaintext in .rdata @ 0x140005100 (g_aes_key), immediately after the 256-byte S-box; the export name 'DllMain' is stored right after the key @ 0x140005110
